extension.summary: Your Pley server's movies, shows and music
extension.description: Browse and play what is on your Pley server: Continue Watching, My List, every library, search and playlists. Pley plays files as they are whenever Kodi can, and converts the rest on the server. Sign in with a code shown on screen, typed on your server's link page.
extension.disclaimer: Pley isn't affiliated with Plex Inc. or Team Kodi.
extension.news:
0.1.0 (2026-10-30) Added:
- Live TV, where the server has channels, laid out as TiviMate does: in the rail after Home, the categories (Search, Favourites, Recently watched, All channels, then the groups, a region's gathered under it), the channels of the one shown by number with what's on now and how far into it, a page at a time, and the focused one's programme and what comes next beside them; a channel's schedule; number keys to go to a channel. Kodi's lists have the same categories. A channel plays in Kodi's own player as the provider sends it (Kodi deinterlaces; surround sound passes through), Next and Previous change channel within its category, and every connection in use says what holds each, with Watch here instead where it may be taken over. Search finds channels too. A channel has no pause, back or forward, as in every app. Lineups of tens of thousands of channels open at once. Needs a server with Live TV.
Security:
- Plain http goes only to addresses on the home network, checked on the connection: sign-in codes and tokens never cross the internet unencrypted. Use the server's https address from elsewhere. - The proxy refuses a negative or unreadable Content-Length, and checks its secret in constant time.
Changed:
- The sign-in page names this app by its address on pley-media-server.github.io. It needs a server from the same release, which keeps it signed in. - Its links point at github.com/pley-media-server/pley. - PGS subtitles come to Kodi as a .sup file...
